breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the distributed self-weight approach with the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ * g * A * (L - x) and integrates it along the bar length using δ = ∫₀ᴸ [P(x) / (A * E)] dx. There is no mention of replacing the distributed load with a single concentrated end load or calling such an approximation 'exact.' This matches the ground truth prompt's approach.
